name: Dr. Eleanor M. Carter
description: Dr. Eleanor M. Carter is a licensed clinical psychologist with over 15 years of experience in assessing and treating mental health disorders. She specializes in cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) and has a strong background in psychological testing and evaluation. Dr. Carter holds a Ph.D. in Clinical Psychology from a prestigious university and has worked in various settings, including private practice, hospitals, and academic institutions. Her primary areas of expertise include anxiety disorders, depression, and personality assessment. She is known for her empathetic approach and ability to create a safe environment for her clients. Dr. Carter is also an adjunct professor at a local university, where she teaches courses on psychological assessment and research methods. She has published several peer-reviewed articles on the effectiveness of CBT in treating anxiety disorders and is a frequent presenter at professional conferences. Dr. Carter is committed to staying updated on the latest research and therapeutic techniques, ensuring that her clients receive evidence-based care.
